ai_settings_bounds_check.name: ai_settings_bounds_check
ai_settings_bounds_check.value: temperature >= 0 and temperature <= 1 and max_tokens between 1 and 2000 and timeout_seconds between 5 and 60 and daily_limit between 1 and 100

ai_settings_endpoint_check.name: ai_settings_endpoint_check
ai_settings_endpoint_check.value: mode = 'mock' or enabled = 0 or (base_url is not null and model is not null)

assessment_target_context.name: assessment_target_context
assessment_target_context.value: (target = 'child' and guardian_id is null and module in ('A','B','C')) or (target = 'guardian' and guardian_id is not null and module = 'W')

children_age.name: children_age
children_age.value: (birth_date is not null and estimated_age is null and age_reference_date is null) or (birth_date is null and estimated_age >= 0 and age_reference_date is not null)

ai_analyses_targets_check.name: ai_analyses_targets_check
ai_analyses_targets_check.value: (scope = 'child' and guardian_id is null) or (scope in ('guardian','combined') and guardian_id is not null)

ai_jobs_targets_check.name: ai_jobs_targets_check
ai_jobs_targets_check.value: (scope = 'child' and guardian_id is null) or (scope in ('guardian','combined') and guardian_id is not null)

ai_jobs_outcome_check.name: ai_jobs_outcome_check
ai_jobs_outcome_check.value: (status = 'succeeded' and analysis_id is not null and safe_error is null) or (status = 'failed' and safe_error is not null and analysis_id is null) or status in ('queued','running')
